response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with strong technical leadership, mentoring abilities, and distributed systems experience. However, he falls significantly short of the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming, possessing less than one year of professional C++ experience from a decade ago. His primary expertise lies in full-stack web technologies (Node.js, TypeScript, DLang) rather than the low-level cloud compute and hardware architecture required for this specific platform role.
strengths: Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience as a Staff Software Engineer, including organizing engineering workshops and coding dojos.
Proven experience building and scaling distributed microservices architectures capable of handling millions of requests per second.
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, establishing engineering best practices like TDD, CI/CD, and robust software design patterns.
concerns: Fails to meet the minimum requirement of 8 years of C++ programming, with only about 7 months of professional C++ experience from 2014-2015.
Core expertise is heavily focused on full-stack web development and higher-level application programming rather than low-level cloud compute infrastructure.
Lacks deep, dedicated experience in hardware architecture, core compute technologies, or low-level network engineering.
